searchText: yes, geth also receives a few bad blocks from `0x4838b106fce9647bdf1e7877bf73ce8b0bad5f97`, titan. It's still producing now can we please get a postmortem about how the "optimistic validation" is working here? the line being sold was, it can happen occasionally, but then that builder/source of invalid blocks will be shut off. evidently not. Are slots being missed because of this? Or are the clients correctly falling back to local building? Slots are being missed, yes. I count 12 missed slots over the last roughly 24 hours, the last one less than an hour ago so it seems to still be misbehaving: 12522156, 12522308, 12522374, 12522764, 12527128, 12527513, 12528117, 12528146, 12528259, 12528277, 12528675, 12529290 All the affected execution payloads had `Titan (titanbuilder.xyz)` set as their extra data. Clients cannot fall back to local because they've already signed a block header at this point. (The relay does return a block header properly but it is for an invalid block.) Seems like it didn't happen often enough to trigger a circuit breaker?
